headerDisplay: Full HomeKit support UniFi Protect devices. See the [homebridge-unifi-protect](https://github.com/mp-consulting/homebridge-unifi-protect) developer page for detailed documentation.
footerDisplay: A working **FFmpeg** installation is required for this plugin to work. For audio support, make sure your version of ffmpeg is compiled with support for the **fdk-aac** codec.

address.title: Controller Address
address.description: Hostname or IP address of your UniFi Protect controller.

duration.title: Message Duration (seconds)
duration.description: Length of time to display the message on your doorbell. Use 0 to display the message indefinitely. Default: 60.

message.title: Message Name
message.description: Message to display on your doorbell. Default: None.

mqttTopic.title: MQTT Base Topic
mqttTopic.description: The base MQTT topic to publish to. Default: unifi/protect.

mqttVerifyTls.title: Verify MQTT Broker TLS Certificate
mqttVerifyTls.description: Validate the MQTT broker's TLS certificate when connecting over mqtts:// or ssl://. Only disable this if your broker uses a self-signed certificate. Default: enabled.

mqttUrl.title: MQTT Broker URL
mqttUrl.description: URL for the MQTT broker you'd like to publish event messages to. Default: None.

name.title: Controller Name
name.description: Name for this UniFi Protect controller to be used for logging purposes. Default: Defined by the controller.

overrideAddress.title: Override Controller Address
overrideAddress.description: Override the address used when livestreaming. This is useful in VPN and remote scenarios where you want to override the address of the UniFi Protect controller. Warning: due to the way stacked Protect controller installations work, this option is unavailable for those configurations.

cameraOverrides.title: Third-Party Camera URL Overrides
cameraOverrides.description: Per-camera RTSP and snapshot URL overrides for ONVIF and other third-party cameras adopted into UniFi Protect. The Protect controller often does not relay these cameras' streams reliably; supply the camera's own URLs here to bypass the controller. Only applied to cameras the controller has flagged as third-party. See docs/onvif-camera-support.md for details.

mac.title: Camera MAC Address
mac.description: MAC address of the third-party camera as reported by the Protect controller. Comparison is case- and separator-insensitive.

rtspUrl.title: Direct RTSP / RTSPS URL
rtspUrl.description: Full RTSP or RTSPS URL pointing directly at the camera's own RTSP server, bypassing the Protect controller. Credentials may be embedded.

snapshotUrl.title: Direct Snapshot URL
snapshotUrl.description: Full HTTP or HTTPS URL pointing at the camera's snapshot endpoint. Credentials may be embedded. Self-signed certificates are accepted.

onvifPort.title: ONVIF Port
onvifPort.description: ONVIF service port remembered for the discovery panel. Leave empty to let the panel try common defaults.

onvifUsername.title: ONVIF Username
onvifUsername.description: Username remembered for the ONVIF discovery panel. Stored in plaintext alongside the controller credentials.

onvifPassword.title: ONVIF Password
onvifPassword.description: Password remembered for the ONVIF discovery panel. Stored in plaintext alongside the controller credentials.

onvifServicePath.title: ONVIF Service Path
onvifServicePath.description: Optional ONVIF device service path remembered for the discovery panel. Defaults to /onvif/device_service when blank.

password.title: Controller Password
password.description: UniFi Protect password for this controller. Creating a homebridge-specific local user is strongly encouraged for security and sanity.

playlistAddress.title: M3U Playlist Bind Address
playlistAddress.description: Local IP address the M3U playlist service (Nvr.Service.Playlist feature option) listens on. Default: all interfaces.

playlistToken.title: M3U Playlist Access Token
playlistToken.description: When set, clients must request the M3U playlist with ?token=<value> in the URL. Without a token, anyone who can reach the playlist port can retrieve your camera stream URLs.

username.title: Controller Username
username.description: UniFi Protect username for this controller. Creating a homebridge-specific local user is strongly encouraged for security and sanity.

verifyTls.title: Verify TLS Certificate
verifyTls.description: Validate the controller's TLS certificate against trusted certificate authorities when connecting. Leave this disabled unless your controller uses a certificate signed by a trusted certificate authority - UniFi controllers use self-signed certificates by default. When disabled, the controller's certificate is pinned the first time HBUP connects, and connections presenting a different certificate are refused. Default: disabled.

debug.title: Debug Logging
debug.description: Enable debug logging for this plugin. This creates a large volume of log output and should only be used when troubleshooting. Default: false.

name.title: Plugin Name
name.description: Name to use for Homebridge logging purposes. Default: UniFi Protect.

items.title: Feature Option
items.description: Enter only one option per entry. Use the feature options webUI tab above unless you know what you're doing.

ringDelay.title: Doorbell Ring Delay (seconds)
ringDelay.description: Delay between doorbell rings. Setting this to a non-zero value will prevent multiple rings of a doorbell over the specified duration.  Default: 0.

verboseFfmpeg.title: Verbose FFmpeg Logging
verboseFfmpeg.description: Enable additional logging for FFmpeg. This will create additional logging when video streams are running. Default: false.

videoProcessor.title: FFmpeg Location
videoProcessor.description: Path to the FFmpeg executable. Most users should not use this setting - FFmpeg is already bundled in the plugin for many platforms. Default: bundled build or the first ffmpeg found in PATH.

items.description: Provide the IP address and login details of your UniFi Protect controllers.
Create additional message presets to display on your UniFi Protect Doorbell.
These settings are optional. The defaults work well for almost everyone.
MQTT support will only be enabled if an MQTT broker URL is specified below.
Use the feature options webUI tab above instead of manually configuring feature options here.
These settings should be rarely used or needed by most people. Use these with caution.
